title: Create a Space gets a framed layout, a step list, a summary and a kit banner

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-10-28: the second step of the Nocturne funnel looks bad; redesign Create a Space for signed-in people

detail:
The wizard floated as a narrow column under the heading with a decorative wash and orb. It now sits in a card under the page heading, with a numbered step list, a 'Your space' summary card beside it where the column is wide enough (a one-line recap otherwise), full-width goal tiles with a hint, and a banner that says which kit is picked when the visitor arrived from a kit page. SparkShell gains an opt-in bare layout, FocusTemplate a wider width and an adminBar pass-through; every other wizard is unchanged. The Look step now names Nocturne, not Midnight.

Steps 3 to 5 (Name, Look, Start) get their own pass in the next PR.

verify.note: Fails on main (standard Spark column, no banner, no summary); passes here.
